impact:
Test runs using RefreshDatabase intermittently fail during the migration phase with SQLSTATE[40P01] Deadlock detected, before any test body executes. Observed repeatedly while working ISS-018: three consecutive identical runs of app/Actions/Tests/AsAuthenticatedTest.php gave 2 failed/3 passed, then 5 passed, then 5 passed, with the failures being deadlocks on foreign-key DDL rather than anything in the tests.

Sample:
```
SQLSTATE[40P01]: Deadlock detected: Process 85155 waits for ShareRowExclusiveLock on relation 9963318;
blocked by process 85366. Process 85366 waits for RowExclusiveLock on relation 9963099; blocked by 85155.
SQL: alter table "server_credential_shares" add constraint "server_credential_shares_user_id_foreign"
     foreign key ("user_id") references "users" ("id") on delete cascade
(Connection: pgsql, Database: dply_testing)
```
Also seen on 2026_06_19_000000_create_server_log_alert_rules_table.php and 2026_06_01_150000_create_server_credential_shares_table.php.

Two Postgres backends are contending, so something else is holding locks on dply_testing while migrations run. `pg_stat_activity` during a run showed an extra `idle in transaction` backend. Not yet identified: whether that is a second concurrent pest process, a worker that resolves to the testing database, or a connection the previous run failed to release.

Why it matters beyond noise: it makes any suite using RefreshDatabase non-deterministic, so a red run cannot be trusted as a real regression and a green one cannot be trusted either. That directly undermines paying down the Modules/App suites, which is the largest coverage lever the project has (see CLAUDE.md), because those runs are exactly the ones being used to measure progress.

Worth checking first whether anything long-running resolves to dply_testing, and whether parallel/TIA runs can overlap migrations on a single shared test database — a per-worker database would remove the contention entirely.

Found while fixing ISS-018; environmental rather than caused by it.
title: RefreshDatabase migrations intermittently deadlock against dply_testing
